parsed.name: 任意函数发生器
parsed.description: Tektronix AFG3021B 是一款台式任意函数发生器，用于产生标准波形和自定义波形电信号，常用于电子电路测试、仪器联调、教学实验以及一般实验室信号激励。
parsed.description_en: The Tektronix AFG3021B is a benchtop arbitrary function generator used to produce standard and user-defined electrical waveforms. It is commonly used for electronics testing, instrument setup, teaching labs, and general laboratory signal stimulation.
